title: Ar-Rahman
body: Ar-Rahman describes Allah's vast, all-embracing mercy, which reaches every creature in this world, believers and non-believers alike. It is the name that opens nearly every surah, in the Bismillah (1:1).

title: Ar-Rahim
body: Ar-Rahim points to Allah's special, continuous mercy toward the believers, above all on the Day of Judgment. Where Ar-Rahman is mercy for all, Ar-Rahim is mercy given to those who turn to Him.

title: Al-Malik
body: Allah is the King who owns and rules everything, with no partner and no one above Him. Surah Al-Fatihah calls Him Master of the Day of Judgment (1:4).

title: Al-Quddus
meaning: The Pure One / The Most Holy
body: Al-Quddus is the One free from every fault, weakness and resemblance to His creation. He is perfectly pure and holy in His essence and in His actions (59:23).

title: As-Salam
body: As-Salam means Allah is free from all defects and is the source of all peace and safety. The believers' greeting, 'As-salamu alaykum', is a prayer for His peace (59:23).

title: Al-Mu'min
meaning: The Inspirer of Faith / The Granter of Security
body: Al-Mu'min gives security and keeps His promises. He gives His servants safety from fear and confirms the truth of His messengers (59:23).

title: Al-Muhaymin
body: Al-Muhaymin is the Guardian who watches over everything and keeps it in His care. Nothing in creation escapes His oversight (59:23).

title: Al-Aziz
body: Al-Aziz is the Almighty whom nothing can overcome, and who gives honor to whom He wills. All true might and dignity come from Him.

title: Al-Jabbar
body: Al-Jabbar is the One whose will is carried out in all things. It is also understood as the One who mends what is broken, including hearts (59:23).

title: Al-Mutakabbir
body: Al-Mutakabbir is the Supreme, whose greatness is beyond all creation. Pride belongs to Allah alone, because He alone deserves it (59:23).

title: Al-Khaliq
body: Al-Khaliq is the Creator who brings things into being and measures them with wisdom. Everything other than Allah is His creation (59:24).

title: Al-Bari'
body: Al-Bari' is the Maker who brings each creature into being, distinct from all others and fitted to its purpose (59:24).

title: Al-Musawwir
body: Al-Musawwir is the Fashioner who gives each creature its own form and appearance (59:24).

title: Al-Ghaffar
body: Al-Ghaffar forgives sins again and again, however often a servant returns to Him. He covers faults and does not expose them.

title: Al-Qahhar
body: Al-Qahhar is the One who overpowers everything, so that all creation is subject to His will. Nothing can resist or escape His command (12:39).

title: Al-Wahhab
body: Al-Wahhab gives freely and constantly, without expecting anything in return. The believers call upon Him by this name in their prayers (3:8).

title: Ar-Razzaq
body: Ar-Razzaq is the Provider who sustains every creature with what it needs. Provision is in His hand alone, which is why believers ask Him for it (51:58).

title: Al-Fattah
body: Al-Fattah opens the doors of mercy, provision and relief, and also judges between people with truth (34:26). Believers turn to Him when a path seems closed.

title: Al-Alim
body: Al-Alim knows everything, seen and unseen, past and future. His knowledge has no beginning and is never lacking or forgotten.

title: Al-Qabid
body: Al-Qabid withholds or tightens provision and other things as He wills, always with wisdom. It is paired with Al-Basit (2:245).

title: Al-Basit
body: Al-Basit extends and expands provision, means and hearts as He wills. Ease and abundance are both from Him (2:245).

title: Al-Khafid
body: Al-Khafid lowers whoever He wills, such as the proud and the unjust. It is paired with Ar-Rafi', since He brings down and raises up (56:3).

title: Ar-Rafi'
body: Ar-Rafi' raises the rank of whoever He wills, through faith and knowledge (58:11). True honor comes from drawing near to Him.

title: Al-Mu'izz
body: Al-Mu'izz gives honor and strength to whom He wills. Real dignity comes from obedience to Him, not from wealth or status (3:26).

title: Al-Mudhill
body: Al-Mudhill humbles those who turn away in arrogance and injustice. Like Al-Qabid, it is best mentioned together with its pair, Al-Mu'izz (3:26).

title: As-Sami'
body: As-Sami' hears every sound, spoken or silent, and every dua. Nothing is too quiet or too far for Him to hear (42:11).

title: Al-Basir
body: Al-Basir sees everything, including the smallest things in the darkest places. Nothing is hidden from His sight (42:11).

title: Al-Hakam
body: Al-Hakam is the Judge whose judgment is final and perfectly just. On the Day of Judgment He will settle every dispute.

title: Al-'Adl
body: Al-'Adl is perfectly just and never wrongs anyone, even by the weight of an atom (4:40). Every right will be returned to its owner.

title: Al-Latif
body: Al-Latif is the Most Gentle, who knows the finest details and brings about good in subtle ways. He often helps His servants in ways they never expected (67:14).

title: Al-Khabir
body: Al-Khabir is aware of the inner reality of all things, including what hearts keep hidden (67:14). Nothing is secret from Him.

title: Al-Halim
body: Al-Halim is the Forbearing, who does not rush to punish. He gives His servants time to repent despite their sins.

title: Al-'Azim
body: Al-'Azim is the Magnificent, whose greatness is beyond what the mind can grasp (2:255). Everything else is small compared to Him.

title: Al-Ghafur
body: Al-Ghafur is the Forgiving, who erases sins and protects the sinner from their consequences. No sin is too great for His forgiveness when a servant sincerely returns to Him.

title: Ash-Shakur
body: Ash-Shakur appreciates and rewards even small good deeds, many times over (35:30). No good act is ever lost with Him.

title: Al-'Aliyy
body: Al-'Aliyy is the Most High, above all creation in rank and power (2:255). Nothing is higher than Him.

title: Al-Kabir
body: Al-Kabir is the Most Great, to whom all greatness belongs (13:9). Everything seems small before His greatness.

title: Al-Hafiz
body: Al-Hafiz is the Preserver who protects the heavens, the earth and every person by His command (12:64). He also preserves every deed in a record.

title: Al-Muqit
body: Al-Muqit is the Sustainer who gives every creature its nourishment and has power over all things (4:85).

title: Al-Hasib
body: Al-Hasib is the Reckoner who is enough for His servant and who also takes account of every deed (4:86). Believers find comfort in knowing He is sufficient for them.

title: Al-Jalil
body: Al-Jalil is the Majestic, who possesses every attribute of greatness. It is the name behind 'Dhul-Jalal' in Surah Ar-Rahman (55:27).

title: Al-Karim
body: Al-Karim is the Generous, who gives beyond what is asked and honors His servants (82:6). His generosity never runs out.

title: Ar-Raqib
body: Ar-Raqib is always watching over everything, so nothing is lost on Him (4:1). Remembering this brings mindfulness in private and in public.

title: Al-Mujib
body: Al-Mujib answers the call of those who ask Him (11:61). He answers in the way and at the time that is best for His servant.

title: Al-Wasi'
body: Al-Wasi' is the All-Encompassing, whose knowledge, mercy and provision have no limit (2:115).

title: Al-Hakim
body: Al-Hakim is perfectly wise in everything He creates and commands. Nothing He does is without purpose, even when we cannot see the reason.

title: Al-Wadud
body: Al-Wadud is the Loving, who loves His righteous servants and is loved by them. It appears beside Al-Ghafur in Surah Al-Buruj (85:14).

title: Al-Majid
body: Al-Majid is the Glorious, whose majesty and generosity are boundless (85:15). It is found in the salawat said in the tashahhud, 'innaka hamidun majid'.

title: Al-Ba'ith
body: Al-Ba'ith will raise the dead on the Day of Judgment (22:7). He also sent messengers to guide mankind.

title: Ash-Shahid
body: Ash-Shahid is the Witness who is present at everything and aware of all that happens (5:117). Nothing is done without His seeing and knowing it.

title: Al-Haqq
body: Al-Haqq is the Truth, whose existence and promises are real and certain (22:6). Everything besides Him depends on Him.

title: Al-Wakil
meaning: The Trustee / The Disposer of Affairs
body: Al-Wakil is the Trustee to whom affairs can be handed over with full confidence. 'Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil' (3:173) is said when facing fear or difficulty.

title: Al-Qawiyy
body: Al-Qawiyy is the All-Strong, whose power never weakens or tires (22:40). Every strength creatures have is from Him.

title: Al-Matin
body: Al-Matin is the Firm, whose strength is steady and unshakable (51:58). Nothing can wear Him down.

title: Al-Waliyy
body: Al-Waliyy is the Protecting Friend who supports the believers and brings them out of darkness into light (2:257).

title: Al-Hamid
body: Al-Hamid is the Praiseworthy, deserving of praise for who He is, whether or not anyone praises Him (31:26). Every blessing a person has is a reason to praise Him.

title: Al-Muhsi
body: Al-Muhsi counts and records everything, from the smallest thing to the deeds of every person. Nothing escapes His account.

title: Al-Mubdi'
body: Al-Mubdi' brings creation into being for the first time, with no earlier example (85:13).

title: Al-Mu'id
body: Al-Mu'id will bring creation back after it perishes, as He began it (85:13). The name points to the resurrection.

title: Al-Muhyi
body: Al-Muhyi gives life, to bodies and also to hearts and dry earth (57:2). Hope can be placed in Him when things seem lifeless.

title: Al-Mumit
body: Al-Mumit decrees death for every living thing at its appointed time (57:2). It is a reminder to prepare for meeting Him.

title: Al-Hayy
body: Al-Hayy is the Ever-Living, whose life has no beginning or end and who never sleeps or tires (2:255). Everything else lives only by His will.

title: Al-Qayyum
body: Al-Qayyum is the Self-Subsisting, who needs nothing and sustains everything else (2:255). It is often joined with Al-Hayy in dua.

title: Al-Wajid
body: Al-Wajid finds all that He wills and lacks nothing. He is never in need, and nothing is out of His reach.

title: Al-Maajid
body: Al-Maajid is the Noble, whose honor and generosity are complete. It is close in meaning to Al-Majid.

title: Al-Wahid
body: Al-Wahid is the One, who has no partner, equal or rival (12:39). It is the heart of tawhid.

title: Al-Ahad
body: Al-Ahad is the Absolute One, unique and without any like Him. Surah Al-Ikhlas begins with it (112:1).

title: As-Samad
body: As-Samad is the Eternal Refuge, who needs no one while everyone needs Him (112:2). People turn to Him for every need.

title: Al-Qadir
body: Al-Qadir has power over all things and is never incapable of anything (2:20). What He wills comes to be.

title: Al-Muqtadir
body: Al-Muqtadir is the All-Powerful, whose power is complete and cannot be prevented (54:42).

title: Al-Muqaddim
body: Al-Muqaddim brings forward whoever and whatever He wills, such as a person, a moment or a matter. He places things in the order His wisdom requires.

title: Al-Mu'akhkhir
body: Al-Mu'akhkhir delays whatever He wills, whether a matter, a punishment or the answer to a dua, always with wisdom. It is paired with Al-Muqaddim.

title: Al-Awwal
body: Al-Awwal is the First, before whom there was nothing (57:3). Everything else has a beginning, but He does not.

title: Al-Akhir
body: Al-Akhir is the Last, who remains after everything has ended (57:3).

title: Az-Zahir
body: Az-Zahir is the Manifest, above all things and clear in His signs (57:3). His existence is evident throughout creation.

title: Al-Batin
body: Al-Batin is the Hidden, who knows the innermost secrets of every heart (57:3).

title: Al-Wali
body: Al-Wali is the Governor who manages the affairs of all creation and is the close ally of the believers.

title: Al-Muta'ali
body: Al-Muta'ali is the Self-Exalted, far above any imperfection and above every description creation can give (13:9).

title: Al-Barr
body: Al-Barr is the Source of Goodness, kind and generous to all His creatures (52:28). In that verse He is mentioned together with Ar-Rahim.

title: At-Tawwab
body: At-Tawwab turns toward His servants in mercy again and again and accepts their repentance. He also inspires them to repent.

title: Al-Muntaqim
body: Al-Muntaqim punishes those who persist in wrongdoing, with perfect justice. It refers to fair retribution, not to personal anger.

title: Al-'Afuww
body: Al-'Afuww pardons sins and wipes them away completely. The Prophet (ﷺ) taught 'A'ishah to ask for it on Laylat al-Qadr: 'Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni'.

title: Ar-Ra'uf
body: Ar-Ra'uf is the Compassionate, whose tenderness is gentle and protective (2:143). He spares His servants from hardship.

title: Malik-ul-Mulk
body: Malik-ul-Mulk is the Owner of all sovereignty, who gives authority to whom He wills and takes it from whom He wills (3:26).

title: Dhul-Jalali wal-Ikram
body: Dhul-Jalali wal-Ikram is the Lord of Majesty and Generosity (55:27). After the salam of the prayer, the Prophet (ﷺ) would say 'Tabarakta ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram'.

title: Al-Muqsit
body: Al-Muqsit is the Equitable, who gives each their due with complete fairness. He loves those who act justly (5:42).

title: Al-Jami'
body: Al-Jami' will gather all people on the Day of Judgment, with no doubt about it (3:9). He also brings together what is scattered.

title: Al-Ghani
body: Al-Ghani is the Self-Sufficient, in need of nothing, while all creation needs Him (47:38). Our worship adds nothing to Him.

title: Al-Mughni
body: Al-Mughni enriches whoever He wills and makes them independent of others. The Prophet (ﷺ) taught that real richness is richness of the soul.

title: Al-Mani'
body: Al-Mani' prevents harm and withholds what is not good for His servants. When something is held back, it can be a protection.

title: Ad-Darr
body: Ad-Darr is the One by whose permission harm reaches anyone, as a test or a consequence, always with wisdom. It is paired with An-Nafi'.

title: An-Nafi'
body: An-Nafi' brings benefit and good. All the benefit people receive ultimately comes from Him.

title: An-Nur
body: An-Nur is the Light, who gives light to the heavens and the earth and guides hearts to faith (24:35).

title: Al-Hadi
body: Al-Hadi is the Guide who shows the way to the truth and helps whom He wills to follow it (25:31). We ask Him in every prayer: 'Guide us to the straight path' (1:6).

title: Al-Badi'
body: Al-Badi' is the Incomparable Originator who created the heavens and the earth with no earlier model (2:117).

title: Al-Baqi
body: Al-Baqi is the Ever-Surviving, who remains when everything else has passed away (55:26-27).

title: Al-Warith
body: Al-Warith is the Inheritor to whom everything returns after creation passes away (15:23). All we have is a loan from Him.

title: Ar-Rashid
meaning: The Guide to the Right Path
body: Ar-Rashid directs all affairs with perfect wisdom, and everything He ordains leads to a right end.

title: As-Sabur
body: As-Sabur is the Patient, who does not hasten to punish. He gives time to those who wrong themselves, so that they may return.
